1.sahih_international: Say, [O Muhammad], "It has been revealed to me that a group of the jinn listened and said, 'Indeed, we have heard an amazing Qur'an.
1.pickthall: Say (O Muhammad): It is revealed unto me that a company of the Jinn gave ear, and they said: Lo! we have heard a marvellous Qur'an,
1.yusuf_ali: Say: It has been revealed to me that a company of Jinns listened (to the Qur'an). They said, 'We have really heard a wonderful Recital!
1.shakir: Say: It has been revealed to me that a party of the jinn listened, and they said: Surely we have heard a wonderful Quran,
1.muhammad_sarwar: (Muhammad), say, "It has been revealed to me that a party of jinn has listened (to the recitation) of the Quran and has told (their people), "We heard an amazing reading
1.mohsin_khan: Say (O Muhammad SAW): "It has been revealed to me that a group (from three to ten in number) of jinns listened (to this Quran). They said: 'Verily! We have heard a wonderful Recital (this Quran)!
1.arberry: Say: 'It has been revealed to me that a company of the jinn gave ear, then they said, "We have indeed heard a Koran wonderful,

2.sahih_international: It guides to the right course, and we have believed in it. And we will never associate with our Lord anyone.
2.pickthall: Which guideth unto righteousness, so we believe in it and we ascribe no partner unto our Lord.
2.yusuf_ali: 'It gives guidance to the Right, and we have believed therein: we shall not join (in worship) any (gods) with our Lord.
2.shakir: Guiding to the right way, so we believe in it, and we will not set up any one with our Lord:
2.muhammad_sarwar: which guides people to the right path and we believe in it. We shall never consider anyone equal to our Lord;
2.mohsin_khan: 'It guides to the Right Path, and we have believed therein, and we shall never join (in worship) anything with our Lord (Allah).
2.arberry: guiding to rectitude. We believe in it, and we will not associate with our Lord anyone.

3.sahih_international: And [it teaches] that exalted is the nobleness of our Lord; He has not taken a wife or a son
3.pickthall: And (we believe) that He - exalted be the glory of our Lord! - hath taken neither wife nor son,
3.yusuf_ali: 'And Exalted is the Majesty of our Lord: He has taken neither a wife nor a son.
3.shakir: And that He-- exalted be the majesty of our Lord-- has not taken a consort, nor a son:
3.muhammad_sarwar: our Lord is too exalted to have either a wife or son.
3.mohsin_khan: 'And exalted be the Majesty of our Lord, He has taken neither a wife, nor a son (or offspring or children).
3.arberry: He -- exalted be our Lord's majesty! has not taken to Himself either consort or a son.

4.sahih_international: And that our foolish one has been saying about Allah an excessive transgression.
4.pickthall: And that the foolish one among us used to speak concerning Allah an atrocious lie.
4.yusuf_ali: 'There were some foolish ones among us, who used to utter extravagant lies against Allah;
4.shakir: And that the foolish amongst us used to forge extravagant things against Allah:
4.muhammad_sarwar: The dimwit one (the devil) among us has been telling confused lies about God.
4.mohsin_khan: 'And that the foolish among us [i.e. Iblis (Satan) or the polytheists amongst the jinns] used to utter against Allah that which was wrong and not right.
4.arberry: The fool among us spoke against God outrage,

5.sahih_international: And we had thought that mankind and the jinn would never speak about Allah a lie.
5.pickthall: And lo! we had supposed that humankind and jinn would not speak a lie concerning Allah -
5.yusuf_ali: 'But we do think that no man or spirit should say aught that untrue against Allah.
5.shakir: And that we thought that men and jinn did not utter a lie against Allah:
5.muhammad_sarwar: We thought that no man or jinn could ever tell lies about God.
5.mohsin_khan: 'And verily, we thought that men and jinns would not utter a lie against Allah.
5.arberry: and we had thought that men and jinn would never speak against God a lie.

6.sahih_international: And there were men from mankind who sought refuge in men from the jinn, so they [only] increased them in burden.
6.pickthall: And indeed (O Muhammad) individuals of humankind used to invoke the protection of individuals of the jinn, so that they increased them in revolt against Allah);
6.yusuf_ali: 'True, there were persons among mankind who took shelter with persons among the Jinns, but they increased them in folly.
6.shakir: And that persons from among men used to seek refuge with persons from among jinn, so they increased them in wrongdoing:
6.muhammad_sarwar: "Certain human beings sought refuge with certain jinn and this increased the rebelliousness of those jinn.
6.mohsin_khan: 'And verily, there were men among mankind who took shelter with the masculine among the jinns, but they (jinns) increased them (mankind) in sin and disbelief.
6.arberry: But there were certain men of mankind who would take refuge with certain men of the jinn, and they increased them in vileness,

7.sahih_international: And they had thought, as you thought, that Allah would never send anyone [as a messenger].
7.pickthall: And indeed they supposed, even as ye suppose, that Allah would not raise anyone (from the dead) -
7.yusuf_ali: 'And they (came to) think as ye thought, that Allah would not raise up any one (to Judgment).
7.shakir: And that they thought as you think, that Allah would not raise anyone:
7.muhammad_sarwar: Those people thought, like you, that God would never send down a Messenger.
7.mohsin_khan: 'And they thought as you thought, that Allah will not send any Messenger (to mankind or jinns).
7.arberry: and they thought, even as you also thought, that God would never raise up anyone.

8.sahih_international: And we have sought [to reach] the heaven but found it filled with powerful guards and burning flames.
8.pickthall: And (the Jinn who had listened to the Qur'an said): We had sought the heaven but had found it filled with strong warders and meteors.
8.yusuf_ali: 'And we pried into the secrets of heaven; but we found it filled with stern guards and flaming fires.
8.shakir: And that we sought to reach heaven, but we found it filled with strong guards and flaming stars.
8.muhammad_sarwar: "We went near the heavens but found it to be full of strong guards and shooting flames.
8.mohsin_khan: 'And we have sought to reach the heaven; but found it filled with stern guards and flaming fires.
8.arberry: And we stretched towards heaven, but we found it filled with terrible guards and meteors.

9.sahih_international: And we used to sit therein in positions for hearing, but whoever listens now will find a burning flame lying in wait for him.
9.pickthall: And we used to sit on places (high) therein to listen. But he who listeneth now findeth a flame in wait for him;
9.yusuf_ali: 'We used, indeed, to sit there in (hidden) stations, to (steal) a hearing; but any who listen now will find a flaming fire watching him in ambush.
9.shakir: And that we used to sit in some of the sitting-places thereof to steal a hearing, but he who would (try to) listen now would find a flame lying in wait for him:
9.muhammad_sarwar: We used to sit near by and try to listen to the heavens, but shooting flames now await those who try to do that.
9.mohsin_khan: 'And verily, we used to sit there in stations, to (steal) a hearing, but any who listens now will find a flaming fire watching him in ambush.
9.arberry: We would sit there on seats to hear; but any listening now finds a meteor in wait for him.

10.sahih_international: And we do not know [therefore] whether evil is intended for those on earth or whether their Lord intends for them a right course.
10.pickthall: And we know not whether harm is boded unto all who are in the earth, or whether their Lord intendeth guidance for them.
10.yusuf_ali: 'And we understand not whether ill is intended to those on earth, or whether their Lord (really) intends to guide them to right conduct.
10.shakir: And that we know not whether evil is meant for those who are on earth or whether their Lord means to bring them good:
10.muhammad_sarwar: We do not know whether by this arrangement God intends benefit and guidance for the people of the earth or only evil.
10.mohsin_khan: 'And we know not whether evil is intended for those on earth, or whether their Lord intends for them a Right Path.
10.arberry: And so we know not whether evil is intended for those in the earth, or whether their Lord intends for them rectitude.

11.sahih_international: And among us are the righteous, and among us are [others] not so; we were [of] divided ways.
11.pickthall: And among us there are righteous folk and among us there are far from that. We are sects having different rules.
11.yusuf_ali: 'There are among us some that are righteous, and some the contrary: we follow divergent paths.
11.shakir: And that some of us are good and others of us are below that: we are sects following different ways:
11.muhammad_sarwar: As for us, some of us are righteous and others are not. We have all followed different ways.
11.mohsin_khan: 'There are among us some that are righteous, and some the contrary; we are groups each having a different way (religious sect, etc.).
11.arberry: And some of us are the righteous, and some of us are otherwise; we are sects differing.

12.sahih_international: And we have become certain that we will never cause failure to Allah upon earth, nor can we escape Him by flight.
12.pickthall: And we know that we cannot escape from Allah in the earth, nor can we escape by flight.
12.yusuf_ali: 'But we think that we can by no means frustrate Allah throughout the earth, nor can we frustrate Him by flight.
12.shakir: And that we know that we cannot escape Allah in the earth, nor can we escape Him by flight:
12.muhammad_sarwar: We knew that we could never challenge God whether we stayed on earth or fled elsewhere.
12.mohsin_khan: 'And we think that we cannot escape (from the punishment of) Allah in the earth, nor can we escape (from the punishment) by flight.
12.arberry: Indeed, we thought that we should never be able to frustrate God in the earth, neither be able to frustrate Him by flight.

13.sahih_international: And when we heard the guidance, we believed in it. And whoever believes in his Lord will not fear deprivation or burden.
13.pickthall: And when we heard the guidance, we believed therein, and whoso believeth in his Lord, he feareth neither loss nor oppression.
13.yusuf_ali: 'And as for us, since we have listened to the Guidance, we have accepted it: and any who believes in his Lord has no fear, either of a short (account) or of any injustice.
13.shakir: And that when we heard the guidance, we believed in it; so whoever believes in his Lord, he should neither fear loss nor being overtaken (by disgrace):
13.muhammad_sarwar: Now that we have listened to the guidance, we believe in it. Whoever believes in his Lord does not need to fear loss or oppression.
13.mohsin_khan: 'And indeed when we heard the Guidance (this Quran), we believed therein (Islamic Monotheism), and whosoever believes in his Lord shall have no fear, either of a decrease in the reward of his good deeds or an increase in punishment for his sins.
13.arberry: When we heard the guidance, we believed in it; and whosoever believes in his Lord, he shall fear neither paltriness nor vileness.

14.sahih_international: And among us are Muslims [in submission to Allah], and among us are the unjust. And whoever has become Muslim - those have sought out the right course.
14.pickthall: And there are among us some who have surrendered (to Allah) and there are among us some who are unjust. And whoso hath surrendered to Allah, such have taken the right path purposefully.
14.yusuf_ali: 'Amongst us are some that submit their wills (to Allah), and some that swerve from justice. Now those who submit their wills - they have sought out (the path) of right conduct:
14.shakir: And that some of us are those who submit, and some of us are the deviators; so whoever submits, these aim at the right way:
14.muhammad_sarwar: Some of us are Muslims and some of us have deviated from the Truth. Whoever has embraced Islam has followed the right guidance.
14.mohsin_khan: 'And of us some are Muslims (who have submitted to Allah, after listening to this Quran), and of us some are Al-Qasitun (disbelievers those who have deviated from the Right Path)'. And whosoever has embraced Islam (i.e. has become a Muslim by submitting to Allah), then such have sought the Right Path."
14.arberry: And some of us have surrendered, and some of us have deviated. Those who have surrendered sought rectitude;

15.sahih_international: But as for the unjust, they will be, for Hell, firewood.'
15.pickthall: And as for those who are unjust, they are firewood for hell.
15.yusuf_ali: 'But those who swerve,- they are (but) fuel for Hell-fire'-
15.shakir: And as to the deviators, they are fuel of hell:
15.muhammad_sarwar: However, the deviators from the Truth will be the fuel for hell".
15.mohsin_khan: And as for the Qasitun (disbelievers who deviated from the Right Path), they shall be firewood for Hell,
15.arberry: but as for those who have deviated, they have become firewood for Gehenna!"'

16.sahih_international: And [Allah revealed] that if they had remained straight on the way, We would have given them abundant provision
16.pickthall: If they (the idolaters) tread the right path, We shall give them to drink of water in abundance
16.yusuf_ali: (And Allah's Message is): "If they (the Pagans) had (only) remained on the (right) Way, We should certainly have bestowed on them Rain in abundance.
16.shakir: And that if they should keep to the (right) way, We would certainly give them to drink of abundant water,
16.muhammad_sarwar: Had they (jinn and mankind) remained steadfast in their religion (Islam), We would certainly have given them abundant water to drink
16.mohsin_khan: If they (non-Muslims) had believed in Allah, and went on the Right Way (i.e. Islam) We should surely have bestowed on them water (rain) in abundance.
16.arberry: Would they but go straight on the way, We would give them to drink of water copious,

17.sahih_international: So We might test them therein. And whoever turns away from the remembrance of his Lord He will put into arduous punishment.
17.pickthall: That We may test them thereby, and whoso turneth away from the remembrance of his Lord; He will thrust him into ever-growing torment.
17.yusuf_ali: "That We might try them by that (means). But if any turns away from the remembrance of his Lord, He will cause him to undergo a severe Penalty.
17.shakir: So that We might try them with respect to it; and whoever turns aside from the reminder of his Lord, He will make him enter into an afflicting chastisement:
17.muhammad_sarwar: as a trial for them. God will make those who disregard the guidance from their Lord suffer increasing torment.
17.mohsin_khan: That We might try them thereby. And whosoever turns away from the Reminder of his Lord (i.e. this Quran, and practice not its laws and orders), He will cause him to enter in a severe torment (i.e. Hell).
17.arberry: that We might try them therein. And whosoever turns away from the Remembrance of his Lord, He will thrust him into chastisement rigorous.

18.sahih_international: And [He revealed] that the masjids are for Allah, so do not invoke with Allah anyone.
18.pickthall: And the places of worship are only for Allah, so pray not unto anyone along with Allah.
18.yusuf_ali: "And the places of worship are for Allah (alone): So invoke not any one along with Allah;
18.shakir: And that the mosques are Allah's, therefore call not upon any one with Allah:
18.muhammad_sarwar: All the parts of the body to be placed on the ground during prostration belong to God.
18.mohsin_khan: And the mosques are for Allah (Alone), so invoke not anyone along with Allah.
18.arberry: The places of worship belong to God; so call not, along with God, upon anyone.

19.sahih_international: And that when the Servant of Allah stood up supplicating Him, they almost became about him a compacted mass."
19.pickthall: And when the slave of Allah stood up in prayer to Him, they crowded on him, almost stifling.
19.yusuf_ali: "Yet when the Devotee of Allah stands forth to invoke Him, they just make round him a dense crowd."
19.shakir: And that when the servant of Allah stood up calling upon Him, they wellnigh crowded him (to death).
19.muhammad_sarwar: Do not prostrate before anyone other than Him. When the servant of God (Muhammad) preached (his message) the jinn would all crowd around him.
19.mohsin_khan: (It has been revealed to me that) When the slave of Allah (Muhammad SAW) stood up invoking (his Lord Allah) in prayer to Him they (the jinns) just made round him a dense crowd as if sticking one over the other (in order to listen to the Prophet's recitation).
19.arberry: When the servant of God stood calling on Him, they were wellnigh upon him in swarms.

20.sahih_international: Say, [O Muhammad], "I only invoke my Lord and do not associate with Him anyone."
20.pickthall: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): I pray unto Allah only, and ascribe unto Him no partner.
20.yusuf_ali: Say: "I do no more than invoke my Lord, and I join not with Him any (false god)."
20.shakir: Say: I only call upon my Lord, and I do not associate any one with Him.
20.muhammad_sarwar: (Muhammad), say, "I worship only my Lord and do not consider anyone equal to Him".
20.mohsin_khan: Say (O Muhammad SAW): "I invoke only my Lord (Allah Alone), and I associate none as partners along with Him."
20.arberry: Say: 'I call only upon my Lord, and I do not associate with Him anyone.

21.sahih_international: Say, "Indeed, I do not possess for you [the power of] harm or right direction."
21.pickthall: Say: Lo! I control not hurt nor benefit for you.
21.yusuf_ali: Say: "It is not in my power to cause you harm, or to bring you to right conduct."
21.shakir: Say: I do not control for you evil or good.
21.muhammad_sarwar: Say, "I do not possess any power to harm or benefit you".
21.mohsin_khan: Say: "It is not in my power to cause you harm, or to bring you to the Right Path."
21.arberry: Say: 'Surely I possess no power over you, either for hurt or for rectitude.'

22.sahih_international: Say, "Indeed, there will never protect me from Allah anyone [if I should disobey], nor will I find in other than Him a refuge.
22.pickthall: Say: Lo! none can protect me from Allah, nor can I find any refuge beside Him
22.yusuf_ali: Say: "No one can deliver me from Allah (If I were to disobey Him), nor should I find refuge except in Him,
22.shakir: Say: Surely no one can protect me against Allah, nor can I find besides Him any place of refuge:
22.muhammad_sarwar: Say, "No one can protect me from God, nor can I find any place of refuge but with him.
22.mohsin_khan: Say (O Muhammad SAW): "None can protect me from Allah's punishment (if I were to disobey Him), nor should I find refuge except in Him.
22.arberry: Say: 'From God shall protect me not anyone, and I shall find, apart from Him, no refuge,

23.sahih_international: But [I have for you] only notification from Allah, and His messages." And whoever disobeys Allah and His Messenger - then indeed, for him is the fire of Hell; they will abide therein forever.
23.pickthall: (Mine is) but conveyance (of the Truth) from Allah, and His messages; and whoso disobeyeth Allah and His messenger, lo! his is fire of hell, wherein such dwell for ever.
23.yusuf_ali: "Unless I proclaim what I receive from Allah and His Messages: for any that disobey Allah and His Messenger,- for them is Hell: they shall dwell therein for ever."
23.shakir: (It is) only a delivering (of communications) from Allah and His messages; and whoever disobeys Allah and His Apostle surely he shall have the fire of hell to abide therein for a long time.
23.muhammad_sarwar: My only (means of protection) is to convey the message of God. Whoever disobeys God and His Messenger will go to hell, wherein he will live forever".
23.mohsin_khan: "(Mine is) but conveyance (of the truth) from Allah and His Messages (of Islamic Monotheism), and whosoever disobeys Allah and His Messenger, then verily, for him is the Fire of Hell, he shall dwell therein forever."
23.arberry: excepting a Deliverance from God and His Messages. And whoso rebels against God and His messenger, for him there awaits the Fire of Gehenna; therein they shall dwell forever.'

24.sahih_international: [The disbelievers continue] until, when they see that which they are promised, then they will know who is weaker in helpers and less in number.
24.pickthall: Till (the day) when they shall behold that which they are promised (they may doubt); but then they will know (for certain) who is weaker in allies and less in multitude.
24.yusuf_ali: At length, when they see (with their own eyes) that which they are promised,- then will they know who it is that is weakest in (his) helper and least important in point of numbers.
24.shakir: Until when they see what they are threatened with, then shall they know who is weaker in helpers and fewer in number.
24.muhammad_sarwar: (On the Day of Judgment) when the disbelievers witness that with which they have been threatened, they will then know whose helpers are weaker and fewer in number.
24.mohsin_khan: Till, when they see that which they are promised, then they will know who it is that is weaker concerning helpers and less important concerning numbers.
24.arberry: Until, when they see that which they are promised, then they will know who is weaker in helpers and fewer in numbers.

25.sahih_international: Say, "I do not know if what you are promised is near or if my Lord will grant for it a [long] period."
25.pickthall: Say (O Muhammad, unto the disbelievers): I know not whether that which ye are promised is nigh, or if my Lord hath set a distant term for it.
25.yusuf_ali: Say: "I know not whether the (Punishment) which ye are promised is near, or whether my Lord will appoint for it a distant term.
25.shakir: Say: I do not know whether that with which you are threatened be nigh or whether my Lord will appoint for it a term:
25.muhammad_sarwar: (Muhammad), say, "I do not know whether that with which you have been threatened is close by or whether my Lord will prolong the time of its coming.
25.mohsin_khan: Say (O Muhammad SAW): "I know not whether (the punishment) which you are promised is near or whether my Lord will appoint for it a distant term.
25.arberry: Say: 'I do not know whether that which you are promised is nigh, or whether my Lord will appoint for it a space;

26.sahih_international: [He is] Knower of the unseen, and He does not disclose His [knowledge of the] unseen to anyone
26.pickthall: (He is) the Knower of the Unseen, and He revealeth unto none His secret,
26.yusuf_ali: "He (alone) knows the Unseen, nor does He make any one acquainted with His Mysteries,-
26.shakir: The Knower of the unseen! so He does not reveal His secrets to any,
26.muhammad_sarwar: He knows the unseen and He does not allow anyone to know His secrets except those of His Messengers whom He chooses.
26.mohsin_khan: "(He Alone) the All-Knower of the Gha'ib (unseen), and He reveals to none His Gha'ib (unseen)."
26.arberry: Knower He of the Unseen, and He discloses not His Unseen to anyone,

27.sahih_international: Except whom He has approved of messengers, and indeed, He sends before each messenger and behind him observers
27.pickthall: Save unto every messenger whom He hath chosen, and then He maketh a guard to go before him and a guard behind him
27.yusuf_ali: "Except a messenger whom He has chosen: and then He makes a band of watchers march before him and behind him,
27.shakir: Except to him whom He chooses as an apostle; for surely He makes a guard to march before him and after him,
27.muhammad_sarwar: He causes angelic guards to march before and after him.
27.mohsin_khan: Except to a Messenger (from mankind) whom He has chosen (He informs him of unseen as much as He likes), and then He makes a band of watching guards (angels) to march before him and behind him.
27.arberry: save only to such a Messenger as He is well-pleased with; then He despatches before him and behind him watchers,

28.sahih_international: That he may know that they have conveyed the messages of their Lord; and He has encompassed whatever is with them and has enumerated all things in number.
28.pickthall: That He may know that they have indeed conveyed the messages of their Lord. He surroundeth all their doings, and He keepeth count of all things.
28.yusuf_ali: "That He may know that they have (truly) brought and delivered the Messages of their Lord: and He surrounds (all the mysteries) that are with them, and takes account of every single thing."
28.shakir: So that He may know that they have truly delivered the messages of their Lord, and He encompasses what is with them and He records the number of all things.
28.muhammad_sarwar: (Messenger) so that He would know that the Messengers have conveyed the message of their Lord. He encompasses all that is with them and He keeps a precise account of all things".
28.mohsin_khan: [He (Allah) protects them (the Messengers)], till He sees that they (the Messengers) have conveyed the Messages of their Lord (Allah). And He (Allah) surrounds all that which is with them, and He (Allah) keeps count of all things (i.e. He knows the exact number of everything).
28.arberry: that He may know they have delivered the Messages of their Lord; and He encompasses all that is with them, and He has numbered everything in numbers.'
